<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/hiring">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Hiring" name="Hiring and onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="Need for a new hire identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateJobDescription" name="Create job description"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostJob" name="Post job on job boards"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectScreenResumes" name="Collect and screen resumes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PhoneInterviews" name="Conduct initial phone interviews"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SelectedForInterview" name="Selected for further interview?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotSelected" name="Candidate not selected for further interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CandidatePreference" name="Candidate interview preference"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteInPerson" name="Invite to in-person interview"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteVirtual" name="Invite to virtual interview"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Merge interview paths"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CandidateChosen" name="Candidate chosen?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotChosen" name="Candidate not chosen"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ExtendOffer" name="Extend offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Negotiation" name="Salary negotiations needed?">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Negotiation</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoNegotiation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SalaryNegotiations" name="Conduct salary negotiations"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcceptanceMerge" name="Merge offer paths"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Receive offer acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompletePaperwork" name="Complete paperwork"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Orientation" name="Complete orientation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Training" name="Complete training"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Integrate" name="Integrate new hire into the team"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Integrated" name="New hire fully integrated"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJob"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_PostJob" targetRef="Task_CollectScreenResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CollectScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_PhoneInterviews" targetRef="Gateway_SelectedForInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="Selected" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectedForInterview" targetRef="Gateway_CandidatePreference">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${selectedForFurtherInterview}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Not selected" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectedForInterview" targetRef="EndEvent_NotSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="Prefers in-person" sourceRef="Gateway_CandidatePreference" targetRef="Task_InviteInPerson">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${candidatePrefersInPerson}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="Prefers virtual" sourceRef="Gateway_CandidatePreference" targetRef="Task_InviteVirtual">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${candidatePrefersVirtual}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_InviteInPerson" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_InviteVirtual" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CandidateChosen"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="Chosen" sourceRef="Gateway_CandidateChosen" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${candidateChosen}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="Not chosen" sourceRef="Gateway_CandidateChosen" targetRef="EndEvent_NotChosen"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_Negotiation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiation" name="Negotiations take place" sourceRef="Gateway_Negotiation" targetRef="Task_SalaryNegotiations">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${salaryNegotiationsNeeded}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoNegotiation" name="No negotiations" sourceRef="Gateway_Negotiation" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptanceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_SalaryNegotiations" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptanceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptanceMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="Task_Orientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_Orientation" targetRef="Task_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_Training" targetRef="Task_Integrate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_Integrate" targetRef="EndEvent_Integrated"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Hiring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_HiringOrganization" name="Hiring organization" processRef="Process_Hiring"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Candidate" name="Candidate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InviteInPerson" sourceRef="Task_InviteInPerson" targetRef="Participant_Candidate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InviteVirtual" sourceRef="Task_InviteVirtual" targetRef="Participant_Candidate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Participant_Candidate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" sourceRef="Participant_Candidate" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
